listing.name: DoDonPachi SaiDaiOuJou / SDOJ-Recomp (eandis)
listing.summary: Play the DoDonPachi SaiDaiOuJou recompilation with your own Xbox 360 disc or Games-on-Demand copy and its Title Update 1 data.

steps.title: Add your own disc or Games-on-Demand files
steps.instruction: Before the first start, put exactly one supported ISO of your own Xbox 360 disc or converted Games-on-Demand copy beside the game program, with its matching Title Update 1 data. Disc default.xex SHA-256 is 709EB9FD2E4446E5754461616693B3BBB8B78FEF5AA613FFCDE6D643DA0133F5 and its TU1 file is 598,016 bytes with SHA-256 0A893048C761BA6CF8ED14637F326726BC616B5183CA1EE52DE02FC12B46B215. The Games-on-Demand default.xex is 41AB091576813248712A387B273398E5D700454505E83F6F1FEB7DE2C1027707 and needs CA022100.binp, CA022110.binp and default.xexp instead. On first start the game checks them, extracts game_data and applies the update; keep your originals separately and delete the copies afterwards.

steps.title: Use a copy you manage yourself
steps.instruction: Keep the complete package for your system together, including its runtime libraries, extractor and notices; the standard and Vulkan ZIPs are separate packages. Start DoDonPachi SaiDaiOuJou.exe (DoDonPachi SaiDaiOuJou on Linux) from its own folder with no arguments. Settings marked as needing a restart apply the next time you start the game.

warnings: Disc and Games-on-Demand copies use different checks and are not interchangeable; do not mix their files. The game refuses incomplete or unsupported game_data rather than merging it. No gameplay, performance or save compatibility across versions is promised.

The package includes statically recompiled game code, icon art and an unlicensed project layer that the project license does not cover. Portcove downloads it only from the project’s own releases. You need your own original game files.

references.title: Keep the game folder's data
references.instruction: By default the game keeps saidaioujou_recomp_tu1.toml, game_data, user_data (saves, the shader cache and update-check notes) and logs beside the program. A game_data_root or other path setting in the toml moves that data elsewhere. In a copy you manage yourself, back these up before replacing the program. The game checks GitHub for new releases and can open the release page; it never downloads or installs them.

presentation.manual_preparation: Before first Play, put exactly one supported ISO of your own DoDonPachi SaiDaiOuJou Xbox 360 disc or converted Games-on-Demand copy, with its matching Title Update 1 files, in the managed game folder beside DoDonPachi SaiDaiOuJou.exe; keep your originals separately. On first Play the game checks them, extracts game_data with its bundled extractor and applies the update; after that you can delete the copied ISO and update files so they are not kept in backups. If extraction fails, the game leaves a game_data.extracting folder beside the program; delete it before trying again. Portcove keeps game_data, user_data (saves and the shader cache), logs and saidaioujou_recomp_tu1.toml across updates, backups and rollback. The game can tell you about a newer upstream release and open its page; it never downloads or installs one, and Portcove replaces the managed program. The game uses Windows path APIs that cannot represent every character, so use a short library path with plain ASCII characters; Portcove refuses other install folders before download.
